name: UI shortcuts help
description: Help mode entries for the UI shortcuts plugin (help@1): the quick-open dialog, its controls, the settings tab and the actions.
author: Brett

entries.title: UI shortcuts
entries.text: Type or say what you want to open: a screen, a dialog, a settings tab, a menu entry, a button, a link. The first match opens on Enter; tap any other match to open it instead.

entries.title: UI shortcuts settings
entries.text: Your own shortcuts (a phrase that opens an item), the microphone and spoken answers, and what is registered for every app.

entries.title: What to open
entries.text: Type a name, an alias, or a sentence like "open the plan studio". Spelling slips are fine: "orkestrator" still finds the Build orchestrator.

entries.title: Open
entries.text: Opens the best match. If several match equally well, the list below shows them so you can pick one.

entries.title: Speak
entries.text: Listens once with this browser's speech recognition and opens what you said. The microphone switch in the settings hides this button.

entries.title: A match
entries.text: One registered item that matches what you typed: its kind, where it belongs and its id. Tap to open it.

entries.title: Kind filter
entries.text: Narrows the matches to one kind of UI: screens, dialogs, settings, menu entries, buttons…

entries.title: Phrase
entries.text: What you will say or type to open the item, exactly ("my plans"). Other wordings go in the aliases.

entries.title: Item
entries.text: The registered item the phrase opens: its id, or words that name it ("plan studio screen"); it is settled to one item when you add the shortcut.

entries.title: Spoken answer
entries.text: What the voice answers when this shortcut runs. Empty = "Opening <item>."

entries.title: Add shortcut
entries.text: Saves the shortcut. It is matched before every other name, so a short phrase can point anywhere.

entries.title: Try
entries.text: Runs the shortcut now, so you can see where it goes.

entries.title: Remove
entries.text: Deletes this shortcut. Nothing else changes.

entries.title: Microphone button
entries.text: Shows the Speak button in the quick-open dialog where the browser can listen. Off hides it; typing still works.

entries.title: Speak the answers
entries.text: Reads the answer aloud ("Opening Plan Studio.") with the browser's voice. Off = answers are only shown.

entries.title: Reload
entries.text: Reads the registry again: how many items every app has and what the open consoles reported.

entries.title: Report this console
entries.text: Sends this console's live UI registry (every screen, dialog, settings tab and action it has right now) to the server, so a just-installed plugin can be opened by voice.

entries.title: UI shortcuts…
entries.text: Opens the quick-open dialog: type or say what to open.

entries.title: Open a registered item
entries.text: The framework action every registered item opens through: ui.open:<item id>. Menus, voice and the API all use it.

entries.title: Say what to open
entries.text: ui-shortcuts.say:<words> opens what the words name, as if you had said them.

steps.say: Type what you want to open, or tap Speak and say it.
Your own phrases live in Settings → Plugins → UI shortcuts.
